remarks: Set gracefully on .67 acres in an established luxury neighborhood, this beautifully designed and meticulously maintained single-story residence blends classic architectural character, thoughtful modernization, and effortless living. Offering 3 generous bedrooms, 3 full baths, and a versatile den, the home is distinguished by quality craftsmanship, expansive gathering spaces, mature gardens, and exceptional indoor-outdoor connection. A striking white brick and stone exterior welcomes you with a wide covered front porch. Mature landscaping creates a private setting, with hydrangeas, rhododendrons, hostas, peonies, and ground cover surrounding outdoor entertaining areas, including a brick patio and aggregate-concrete patio. Inside, a gracious ceramic-tile foyer opens to a handsome den with paneled walls, built-in cabinetry, counters, and bookshelves—ideal as an office, library, or retreat. The formal living room features a wood-burning fireplace, bow window, and oak floors, while the expansive dining room offers matching oak flooring. The remarkable family room showcases a cathedral ceiling with exposed wood beams, brick hearth, wood-burning fireplace, built-ins, and rich cherry paneling. A 12-foot Pella sliding-door opens to the patios and gardens. The recently updated kitchen combines sophisticated finishes with exceptional practicality, featuring a breakfast area, custom bay window, walk-in pantry, high-end stainless-steel appliances, and large island. A ceramic-tile rear hall provides garage and side-yard access and includes two large closets plus a full bath with redwood sauna. The laundry room offers a utility sink, cabinetry, and additional closet. The private primary suite features a newly renovated accessible bath, 22-square-foot cedar closet, 2 walk-in closets, and floor-to-ceiling storage. Two additional large bedrooms.  Newer furnaces, AC, generator and security system. Throughout, this exceptional residence showcases architectural integrity, quality materials, thoughtful updates, extensive storage, and landscaped grounds—creating a home of enduring elegance, comfort, and distinction.
